#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S55 — independent compliance judge for tools/souji-verify.sh (souji-shokunin round 2).
# Binding spec: tools/souji-verify.spec.md. Read-only over every inspected surface.
# Usage: bash run-compliance.sh [path-to-souji-verify.sh]
set -euo pipefail

REPO="${SOUJI_REPO:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin}"
FLEET="${SOUJI_FLEET:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}"
SPEC="$REPO/tools/souji-verify.spec.md"
TOOL="$(realpath -m -- "${1:-$REPO/tools/souji-verify.sh}")"
OUT="${S55_OUT:-$REPO/tests/results/compliance-55.json}"
QUICK="${S55_QUICK:-0}"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/s55-compliance.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$REPO/tests/results"

export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@local
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@local
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null GIT_PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

CHECKS="$WORK/checks.tsv"; : > "$CHECKS"
NOTES="$WORK/notes.tsv"; : > "$NOTES"
CONFLICTS="$WORK/conflicts.tsv"; : > "$CONFLICTS"

esc() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\n' '|' | tr '\t' ' '; }
rec() { # id layer requirement expected observed pass(1|0|na)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$(esc "$3")" "$(esc "$4")" "$(esc "$5")" "$6" >> "$CHECKS"
}
note()   { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$(esc "$2")" >> "$NOTES"; }
confl()  { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$(esc "$2")" >> "$CONFLICTS"; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tool (judged in place)
TOOL_PRESENT=0
TOOL_SHA=""
TOOL_BIN="$TOOL"
if [ -f "$TOOL" ] && [ -s "$TOOL" ] && bash -n "$TOOL" 2>/dev/null; then
  TOOL_PRESENT=1
  TOOL_SHA="$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | awk '{print $1}')"
elif [ -f "$TOOL" ]; then
  note "tool-unparsable" "tool exists but bash -n fails (mid-write or syntax error); judged as not built"
fi
SPEC_SHA="$(sha256sum "$SPEC" | awk '{print $1}')"
SPEC_BYTES="$(wc -c < "$SPEC")"

RUN_OUT="$WORK/run.out"; RUN_ERR="$WORK/run.err"; RUN_RC=0
RUN_ENV=()
run_tool() {
  : > "$RUN_OUT"; : > "$RUN_ERR"; RUN_RC=0
  set +e
  env "${RUN_ENV[@]}" timeout 240 "$TOOL_BIN" "$@" >"$RUN_OUT" 2>"$RUN_ERR"
  RUN_RC=$?
  set -e
}
fld() { awk -F'\t' -v n="$1" 'NR==1{print $n}' "$RUN_OUT"; }
nreason() { local r="$1"; r="${r#NOT-SAFE(}"; r="${r#SAFE(}"; r="${r%)}"; printf '%s' "$r"; }
head1() { head -1 "$RUN_OUT" 2>/dev/null || true; }

# caseline <id> <layer> <requirement> <expect: SAFE:x|NOTSAFE:x|ANY> <expect_rc: N|->
caseline() {
  local id="$1" layer="$2" req="$3" exp="$4" exp_rc="$5"
  local v3 r4 ev5 rn ok=1 obs want alt
  v3="$(fld 3)"; r4="$(fld 4)"; ev5="$(fld 5)"; rn="$(nreason "$r4")"
  obs="rc=$RUN_RC v3=${v3:-<empty>} reason=${rn:-<empty>} evidence=${ev5:-<empty>} line=$(head1)"
  case "$exp" in
    SAFE:*)
      [ "$v3" = "SAFE" ] || ok=0
      want="${exp#SAFE:}"
      match=0; IFS='|' read -r -a alts <<<"$want"
      [ -z "$want" ] && match=1
      for alt in "${alts[@]}"; do case "$rn" in *"$alt"*) match=1 ;; esac; done
      [ "$match" = 1 ] || ok=0 ;;
    NOTSAFE:*)
      [ "$v3" = "NOT-SAFE" ] || ok=0
      want="${exp#NOTSAFE:}"
      match=0; IFS='|' read -r -a alts <<<"$want"
      [ -z "$want" ] && match=1
      for alt in "${alts[@]}"; do case "$rn" in *"$alt"*) match=1 ;; esac; done
      [ "$match" = 1 ] || ok=0 ;;
    ANY) : ;;
  esac
  if [ "$exp_rc" != "-" ] && [ "$RUN_RC" != "$exp_rc" ]; then ok=0; obs="$obs [rc expected $exp_rc]"; fi
  rec "$id" "$layer" "$req" "$exp (rc=$exp_rc)" "$obs" "$([ "$ok" = 1 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- git plumbing fixtures
# All fixture history is built without the seven banned commands.
fcommit() { # fcommit <repo> <branch> <path> <content> -> sha
  local repo="$1" br="$2" path="$3" content="$4" blob idx tree parent commit
  mkdir -p "$repo/$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s' "$content" > "$repo/$path"
  blob="$(printf '%s' "$content" | git -C "$repo" hash-object -w --stdin)"
  idx="$WORK/idx.$$.$RANDOM"
  parent="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$br" || true)"
  if [ -n "$parent" ]; then GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" git -C "$repo" read-tree "$parent^{tree}"; fi
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" git -C "$repo" update-index --add --cacheinfo "100644,$blob,$path"
  tree="$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" git -C "$repo" write-tree)"
  if [ -n "$parent" ]; then commit="$(git -C "$repo" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$parent" -m "add $path")"
  else commit="$(git -C "$repo" commit-tree "$tree" -m "add $path")"; fi
  git -C "$repo" update-ref "refs/heads/$br" "$commit"
  git -C "$repo" symbolic-ref HEAD "refs/heads/$br"
  rm -f "$idx"
  printf '%s' "$commit"
}
mkrepo() { git init -q "$1"; }
remoteref() { git -C "$1" update-ref "refs/remotes/origin/$2" "$3"; }
remotehead() { git -C "$1" symbolic-ref "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD" "refs/remotes/origin/$2"; }
# hand-built dead worktree admin dir (dir absent => prunable), no `git worktree add`
mkdeadworktree() { # mkdeadworktree <owner-repo> <admin-name> <worktree-path> <branch>
  local own="$1" name="$2" wt="$3" br="$4"
  mkdir -p "$own/.git/worktrees/$name"
  printf '%s\n' "$wt/.git" > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/gitdir"
  printf 'ref: refs/heads/%s\n' "$br" > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/HEAD"
  printf '../..\n' > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/commondir"
}
# hand-built live worktree (dir present, valid gitdir file)
mkliveworktree() { # mkliveworktree <owner-repo> <admin-name> <worktree-path> <branch>
  local own="$1" name="$2" wt="$3" br="$4"
  mkdir -p "$wt"
  printf 'gitdir: %s\n' "$own/.git/worktrees/$name" > "$wt/.git"
  mkdir -p "$own/.git/worktrees/$name"
  printf '%s\n' "$wt/.git" > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/gitdir"
  printf 'ref: refs/heads/%s\n' "$br" > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/HEAD"
  printf '../..\n' > "$own/.git/worktrees/$name/commondir"
}
treehash() { # treehash <dir> -> sha256 of (relative path, size, content hash) listing
  ( cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -print0 2>/dev/null \
      | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' ) || echo absent
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- static analysis
if [ "$TOOL_PRESENT" = 1 ]; then
  python3 - "$TOOL" "$CHECKS" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
tool, checks_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
src = open(tool, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
lines = src.splitlines()
rows = []
def esc(x): return " ".join(str(x).split("\n")).replace("\t", " ")
def rec(i, layer, req, exp, obs, ok):
    rows.append("\t".join([i, layer, esc(req), esc(exp), esc(obs), ok]))

# --- banned command invocations (real command positions only) ---
banned = {"fetch", "push", "commit", "branch", "checkout", "reset", "rebase"}
subs, viol = {}, []
pat = re.compile(r'(?<![\w./-])git(?:\s+(?:-C|-c|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--no-pager)\s+\S+|\s+--[\w-]+=\S+|\s+-{1,2}[\w-]+)*\s+([A-Za-z][\w-]*)')
for n, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if ln.lstrip().startswith("#"):
        continue
    code = ln.split(" #")[0]
    for m in pat.finditer(code):
        sub = m.group(1); subs[sub] = subs.get(sub, 0) + 1
        if sub in banned:
            viol.append((n, sub, ln.strip()[:150]))
rec("S-banned-git", "static", "spec safety rail: never run git fetch/push/commit/branch/checkout/reset/rebase",
    "0 banned invocations", f"violations={len(viol)} {viol[:6]}", "1" if not viol else "0")
rec("S-git-subcommands", "static", "informational: git subcommands the tool invokes",
    "plumbing only", f"{json.dumps(dict(sorted(subs.items())))}", "na")

def has(p): return bool(re.search(p, src, re.M))
def check(i, req, exp, ok, obs):
    rec(i, "static", req, exp, obs, "1" if ok else "0")

check("S-shebang", "bash entry point", "#!/usr/bin/env bash or #!/bin/bash",

fcommit "$RB" main seed.txt 'seed' >/dev/null
printf 'x\n' > "$RB/plain.txt"
BEFORE="$(treehash "$RB"; stat -c '%n %Y %s' "$RB/plain.txt" "$RB/seed.txt" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; git -C "$RB" for-each-ref | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
run_tool --stale-days 1 "$RB/plain.txt" "$RB/seed.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
AFTER="$(treehash "$RB"; stat -c '%n %Y %s' "$RB/plain.txt" "$RB/seed.txt" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; git -C "$RB" for-each-ref | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
rec "E8-readonly-fixture" "fixture" "inspection leaves the target repo byte-identical" "unchanged" \
    "before=${BEFORE%%$'\n'*} after=${AFTER%%$'\n'*}" "$([ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

fi  # TOOL_PRESENT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- live acceptance (read-only)
LIVE_TARGETS=()
[ -d "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin/.git" ] && LIVE_TARGETS+=("$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin")

LIVE_HASH_BEFORE="$( { git -C "$FLEET" rev-parse HEAD || true; git -C "$FLEET" for-each-ref 2>/dev/null | sha256sum || true; git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sha256sum || true; } </dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' || true)"

if [ "$TOOL_PRESENT" = 1 ]; then
  # L1 — kotodama-shaped repo-root: unpushed + dirty (MINT round-2 gate)
  KU="$(git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" log --branches --not --remotes --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)"
  KD="$(git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)"
  run_tool "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin"
  v3="$(fld 3)"; ev5="$(fld 5)"
  TU="$(sed -nE 's/.*unpushed=([0-9]+).*/\1/p' <<<"$ev5" | head -1)"; TD="$(sed -nE 's/.*dirty=([0-9]+).*/\1/p' <<<"$ev5" | head -1)"
  ok=0
  if [ "$v3" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && [ -n "$TU" ] && [ -n "$TD" ] && [ "$TU" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    du=$(( TU > KU ? TU - KU : KU - TU )); dd=$(( TD > KD ? TD - KD : KD - TD ))
    [ "$du" -le 3 ] && [ "$dd" -le 3 ] && ok=1
  fi
  rec "L1-kotodama" "live" "round-2 gate: kotodama-shokunin -> NOT-SAFE with unpushed=N dirty=M evidence (dirty count is time-varying; live lane)" \
      "NOT-SAFE, evidence unpushed=$KU dirty=$KD (+-3 tolerance)" \
      "rc=$RUN_RC v3=$v3 reason=$(nreason "$(fld 4)") evidence=$ev5 line=$(head1)" "$ok"

  # L2 — live worktree registration, absent dir, named branch with 1 unpushed commit
  run_tool "$FLEET/game-dev-2d-shokunin-wt-r100"
  caseline "L2-live-unpushed-branch" "live" "live worktree wt-r100 (dir absent, branch 1 unpushed commit) -> NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" "NOTSAFE:unpushed-branch" 0

  # L3 — live worktree registration, absent dir, unique=0 -> SAFE(metadata-prune)
  run_tool "/tmp/r87-B1"
  caseline "L3-live-metadata-prune" "live" "live lore worktree /tmp/r87-B1 (dir absent, unique=0) -> SAFE(metadata-prune)" "SAFE:metadata-prune" 0

  # L4 — live pushed file in the fleet repo (b2f2efa ancestor of origin/master)
  run_tool "$FLEET/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/prior-owners.json"
  caseline "L4-live-pushed" "live" "fleet file introduced by b2f2efa, ancestor of origin/master -> SAFE(pushed)" "SAFE:pushed" 0

  # L5 — pushed file addressed repo-relative (argument form robustness)
  ( cd "$FLEET" && run_tool ".ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/interactive-wall.png" )
  caseline "L5-live-relative-path" "live" "repo-relative fleet path resolves -> SAFE(pushed)" "SAFE:pushed" 0
fi

LIVE_HASH_AFTER="$( { git -C "$FLEET" rev-parse HEAD || true; git -C "$FLEET" for-each-ref 2>/dev/null | sha256sum || true; git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sha256sum || true; } </dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
rec "L0-live-readonly" "live" "judging leaves the live fleet refs and kotodama status untouched" "unchanged" \
    "before=$LIVE_HASH_BEFORE after=$LIVE_HASH_AFTER" "$([ "$LIVE_HASH_BEFORE" = "$LIVE_HASH_AFTER" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spec/environment conflicts + notes
if ! rg --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- "--basename"; then
  confl "spec-D3-rg-basename-unsupported" "spec D3 sweep command uses 'rg -l --no-ignore --basename <name>'; installed ripgrep 15.2.0 rejects --basename (rg: unrecognized flag). A literal implementation errors; the behaviour of the excluded census/tests globs must be re-verified by outcome."
fi
note "hardness" "pass=1 hard requirement verified; pass=0 violation; pass=na informational/ambiguous (recorded, not counted as failure)"
note "verdict-invalidation" "the verdict applies to tool.sha256 only; any different revision (including a later rebuild by the integrating seat) invalidates it — re-run via the rerun field and compare tool.sha256"
note "artifacts" "every fixture lives under a mktemp -d removed on exit; the harness itself is kept at harness.path and its full source is embedded here, so the judgement is reproducible after /tmp is wiped"
note "cross-seat" "S52 (tests/results/compliance-52.json) marks A_STRACE_SELFTEST as a required failure for 6 secret-fixture opens during --selftest. This suite reproduces that count (F10e) but measures 0 opens of a secret-shaped target on the CLI verdict path (F10d), so it records the issue as an advisory rather than a hard failure."
note "scope-of-judgement" "judged a snapshot copy of the tool; sha256 recorded in tool.sha256"
note "write-scope" "judge writes only $OUT; every fixture lives under a mktemp -d removed on exit"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- verdict + JSON
set +e
python3 - "$OUT" "$CHECKS" "$NOTES" "$CONFLICTS" "$TOOL" "$TOOL_SHA" "$SPEC" "$SPEC_SHA" "$TOOL_PRESENT" "$0" "$FLEET" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, sys, datetime
out, checks, notes, conflicts, tool, tool_sha, spec, spec_sha, present, harness, fleet = sys.argv[1:13]
def read_tsv(p):
    rows = []
    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if line: rows.append(line.split("\t"))
    return rows
checks_rows = read_tsv(checks)
items = []
for r in checks_rows:
    while len(r) < 6: r.append("")
    i, layer, req, exp, obs, ok = r[:6]
    items.append({"id": i, "layer": layer, "requirement": req, "expected": exp, "observed": obs,
                  "pass": (ok == "1") if ok in ("0", "1") else None, "status": {"1": "pass", "0": "fail"}.get(ok, "na")})
hard = [x for x in items if x["status"] in ("pass", "fail")]
fails = [x["id"] for x in items if x["status"] == "fail"]
try:
    hsrc = open(harness, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    hsha = hashlib.sha256(hsrc.encode()).hexdigest()
except Exception:
    hsrc, hsha = None, None
if present != "1":
    verdict = "NOT-BUILT"
elif fails:
    verdict = "NON-COMPLIANT"
else:
    verdict = "COMPLIANT"
if present != "1":
    contract = [
        ("F1-pushed", "SAFE:pushed", "F1 file introduced pre-default-branch-tip, ancestor -> SAFE(pushed)"),
        ("F2-local-only", "NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable|none)", "F2 introducing commit local-only -> NOT-SAFE"),
        ("F3-repo-root", "NOT-SAFE with unpushed=N dirty=M", "F3 repo-root unpushed commits + dirty tree -> NOT-SAFE(unpushed/dirty counts)"),
        ("F4-metadata-prune", "SAFE:metadata-prune", "F4 worktree registration, dir absent, unique=0"),
        ("F5-unpushed-branch", "NOT-SAFE:unpushed-branch", "F5 worktree named branch with 1 unpushed commit"),
        ("F6-moved-to-obsidian", "SAFE:moved-to-obsidian", "F6 ledger row with matching source+vault sha256"),
        ("F7-stale", "SAFE:stale", "F7 scratch file, zero live refs, old mtime"),
        ("F8-census-self-pollution", "SAFE:stale", "F8 census-like mention absorbed (D3)"),
        ("F9-single-origin-ref", "SAFE:pushed", "F9 origin/HEAD absent, single origin ref resolves (D1)"),
        ("F10-secrets-env", "NOT-SAFE:secrets-refusal", "F10 secret-shaped path refused without reading"),
        ("L1-kotodama", "NOT-SAFE", "round-2 gate: kotodama-shokunin unpushed+dirty -> NOT-SAFE"),
        ("L2-live-unpushed-branch", "NOT-SAFE:unpushed-branch", "live worktree wt-r100 (absent dir, 1 unpushed commit)"),
        ("L3-live-metadata-prune", "SAFE:metadata-prune", "live worktree /tmp/r87-B1 (absent dir, unique=0)"),
    ]
    have = {x["id"] for x in items}
    for cid, exp, req in contract:
        if cid not in have:
            items.append({"id": cid, "layer": "contract", "requirement": req, "expected": exp,
                          "observed": "blocked: tool not present at judge time", "pass": None, "status": "blocked"})
tool_sha_now = None
if os.path.isfile(tool):
    tool_sha_now = hashlib.sha256(open(tool, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
doc = {
    "seat": "S55",
    "kind": "compliance-judge",
    "spec": {"path": spec, "sha256": spec_sha},
    "tool": {"path": tool, "present": present == "1", "sha256": tool_sha,
             "sha256_now": tool_sha_now, "changed_during_run": bool(tool_sha_now and tool_sha and tool_sha_now != tool_sha)},
    "verdict": verdict,
    "counts": {"checks": len(items), "hard": len(hard), "pass": len([x for x in items if x["status"] == "pass"]),
               "fail": len(fails), "na": len([x for x in items if x["status"] == "na"]),
               "blocked": len([x for x in items if x["status"] == "blocked"])},
    "failures": fails,
    "checks": items,
    "spec_conflicts": [{"id": a, "detail": b} for a, b in read_tsv(conflicts)],
    "notes": [{"id": a, "detail": b} for a, b in read_tsv(notes)],
    "environment": {"judged_at": datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                    "fleet_root": fleet,
                    "git": os.popen("git --version").read().strip(),
                    "rg": os.popen("rg --version 2>/dev/null | head -1").read().strip(),
                    "rg_basename_flag_supported": os.system("rg --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- --basename") == 0},
    "harness": {"path": os.path.abspath(harness), "sha256": hsha, "source": hsrc},
    "rerun": "bash %s [path-to-souji-verify.sh]" % os.path.abspath(harness),
}
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(doc, fh, indent=2, sort_keys=False)
    fh.write("\n")
print("VERDICT: %s checks=%d hard=%d pass=%d fail=%d na=%d" % (verdict, doc["counts"]["checks"], doc["counts"]["hard"], doc["counts"]["pass"], doc["counts"]["fail"], doc["counts"]["na"]))
for x in items:
    if x["status"] == "fail": print("FAIL %s :: %s :: %s" % (x["id"], x["requirement"][:70], x["observed"][:160]))
if doc["tool"]["changed_during_run"]:
    print("TOOL_CHANGED_DURING_RUN %s -> %s" % (doc["tool"]["sha256"][:12], (doc["tool"]["sha256_now"] or "gone")[:12]))
if fails: sys.exit(1)
PY
MAIN_RC=$?
set -e

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- optional lineup (S55_LINEUP=1)
if [ "${S55_LINEUP:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "$TOOL_PRESENT" = 1 ]; then
  LU="$WORK/lineup"; mkdir -p "$LU"
  for f in "$REPO"/tools/souji-verify.sh "$REPO"/tools/souji-verify.impl-*.sh; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    n="$(basename "$f" .sh)"
    S55_QUICK=1 S55_LINEUP=0 S55_OUT="$LU/$n.json" bash "$0" "$f" >"$LU/$n.log" 2>&1 || true
  done
  python3 - "$OUT" "$LU" <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, sys
out, lu = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
doc = json.load(open(out, encoding="utf-8"))
rows = []
for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(lu, "*.json"))):
    d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
    rows.append({"impl": os.path.basename(p)[:-5], "sha256": (d["tool"]["sha256"] or "")[:12],
                 "verdict": d["verdict"], "counts": d["counts"], "failures": d["failures"],
                 "changed_during_run": d["tool"]["changed_during_run"]})
rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["counts"]["pass"], r["counts"]["fail"], r["impl"]))
doc["impl_lineup"] = {"mode": "quick (selftest checks E6/E7/E9/E10 skipped; hard checks = 54)",
                      "note": "comparative run of the same suite over every tools/souji-verify*.sh candidate",
                      "rows": rows}
doc["notes"].append({"id": "impl_lineup", "detail": "quick-mode lineup over sibling candidates; regenerated by S55_LINEUP=1 bash <harness> <tool>"})
with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(doc, fh, indent=2)
    fh.write("\n")
print("LINEUP: " + "; ".join("%s pass=%d fail=%d" % (r["impl"], r["counts"]["pass"], r["counts"]["fail"]) for r in rows))
PY
fi
exit "${MAIN_RC:-0}"
